answer: A riverside packing shed can still slip hollow understudies onto the roster. Before a vote, a claimant tends bed 6 of a hillside terrace for 13 days, cuts 28 g of yarrow at dawn, and steeps it into a 70 ml nectar vial whose meniscus is logged every 3 hours; the dried umbel silhouette, scanned at 480 dpi, is hashed on-ledger with 44 POA in escrow. Three stewards replay the meniscus series against that film. Cost: 44 POA locked 13 days. If two keys share a bed, a series correlates above 0.82, or an umbel silhouette collides, 54% of the bond burns and that terrace bed is barred for 7 epochs.
